notes.title: Are we liars???
notes.content:
[p]Many people, upon seeing the new covers, thought they were made with AI; nothing could be further from the truth. The covers are made with a drawing style that mimics rotoscoping. We use images of people posing as references, then sketch the body in that position, and after painting it, we add textures. We also edit the images with PicsArt and draw the covers in HiPaint. We'll be showing several sketches and even unfinished projects.
No AI is used in this project. Light BOOM!!! has strict rules regarding content; you must create it yourself. It's also important to note that we're new to creating covers and illustrations, so sometimes they aren't very intuitive.[/p][p]Don't worry about the quality of our content, we'll keep in touch about everything. We'll even read suggestions for adding them to the game.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45668872/01a993b515b2557c141371b5e4ac74ec6ca019f5.jpg"][/img]We need to clarify that generative AI or AI tools are NOT used at any time. Everything is done manually or with simple effects tools. While PicsArt has AI tools, we do not use them at any time, and this could cause confusion or misunderstandings. This statement is only to clarify that our content is created by us legally and without violating copyrights or community standards.[/p][p][/p][p](Remember to keep things healthy; we can't hold personal conversations. Also, please don't use the comment channels or texts to comment on obscene or irrelevant things. Always maintain a respectful tone and clear communication to achieve better teamwork.)[/p]

notes.title: Behind the development
notes.content:
[p]The game is being developed using the Godot engine, and is programmed using GDScript. For those who have questions about how the covers were created, they were originally created using mobile apps like HiPaint, which were then edited in PicsArt to correct color or contrast issues.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45668872/95c9f5b1acbaf31770c597fc9211c6e1a5a63f6b.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45668872/4095cfa020bd38bee70e39cd419573ae29d45416.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45668872/b1290e2c93e126a41b88f622b66314f26473c221.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45668872/7077c9ffd97a2d778a145caab0dfd90d576942b4.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45668872/efd392259bc1a8892f9daa0d4825bf0fdbd98da5.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45668872/c5b78e8ba76e8b30344844b8e551f75e500aa4df.jpg"][/img]The character was simplified to give it more distinction from the background, but it may still feel strange to some. We'll still be working on more things. notes.title: More improvements, much better
notes.content:
[p]More graphical improvements are coming. We're working on advanced post-processing, and not only that, but new maps and enemies are coming as well. We're very excited about the content we're preparing.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45668872/32416e4108205d6b145c958676f9c95a3f93e5db.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45668872/30c36277870738504a0700204e22ce2a3eaa7600.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45668872/c01b358428e658eeed9190d29489b75375c59865.png"][/img]There will be a very well-crafted setting for each map. I'm also working on a unique visual style; I don't want it to be just realistic. That's not my goal.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45668872/5f48968a7ad6f3fc3bdb845ceff74ea1f6305c70.png"][/img]There was also a change to the amras to make them feel better, which brings us to the next point: the FVX particles and effects.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45668872/08415fd4e8d9d7a8464878a148e38650a0a46be6.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45668872/30c36277870738504a0700204e22ce2a3eaa7600.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45668872/14732775d6fa1ccf55ae008463cd1bf23d9c5678.png"][/img]

These are the new particle improvements.

For those who are more interested in this, you can go to my networks and my official TikTok accounts to get everything first thing in the morning.[/p]

notes.title: Say goodbye to the girls in our games.
notes.content: [p]Due to a controversy, the Collective Shout group has imposed rules on payment processors and Steam. We agree on some points, but removing games that only feature women and anime-style Wifus without first checking whether they had violations was very abrupt. This isn't anyone's fault; Valve doesn't want to tarnish their reputation. We at Light BOOM!!! wish Valve and other indie developers the best as professionals.[/p][p]For my part, I don't have a position. We feel it's a strong movement and a big problem for us developers. Valve's inconsistencies on the platform may vary from game to game. I understand that there are groups that want to maintain a positive image of women. I know, but this isn't the way to do it. Yes, I'm against games that promote child and animal abuse. But it's no reason to randomly take down games. Valve is doing what it can; I, for one, will avoid problems and follow their new rules for contributing to the store. There will be no more female characters. I hope Valve gets the chance to do something and improve the system a little more.[/p][p]I'm not really upset, but I am scared. Things like this could end the gaming world :([/p]

notes.title: WARNING!
notes.content: [p]This is a message for the Japanese: I'm with you. I know how it feels to be ashamed of a politician from your country. I know how a broken heart feels when you know that at some point in history, your country of birth fell so low. I want to do my part. Ridiculing Hirohito is the least I can do. Although I can't give in-depth messages about what they suffered, I want them to know that I support them as a community. I truly love their culture. Cheers to Japan! 🤍❤️[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45668872/adeff03497696a6b84b5fdbf4a1000e0c85e8f51.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Full Graphics
notes.content: [p]Ultra graphics mode has been added for fairly powerful PCs. It's a mode without the VHS effect, allowing you to see the world around you in better quality. (WARNING: PCs with minimum requirements will not be able to run in this mode.) It's more reliable to opt for VHS mode if your PC isn't powerful enough to run it with ultra graphics.[/p]
